written: 2026-11-24, after the dev stage (seeds 101-103), before any held-out run
e3_lambda_rule: argmin mean dev RMSE vs theta_27 over quant30 and gauss005 at 10 Hz (dev only)

estimands.E1: theta_05 = mean true tangential accel on [t_exit, t_exit+0.5]
estimands.E3: theta_27 = mean true tangential accel on [t_exit+0.2, t_exit+0.7]

required: R_meas >= 0.80 in both calibrated scenarios (error variance <= 25% of true trial-level variance)
failure rate <= 10% in both calibrated scenarios
desirable: 95% coverage within [0.90, 0.98] in both calibrated scenarios
selection: among estimators meeting all required criteria, the one with the highest mean R_meas over the calibrated scenarios; if none meets them, Stage E fails and no real-data analysis is run
